title: At a location without QuickBooks nothing is sent and Close works as usual
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have access to the QuickBooks Online company of the test location, so its journal entries can be read.
  • Use an organization with two locations: location A connected to QuickBooks Online, location B not connected.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete at location B, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2.
  • Work at location B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
  3. Click Close Work Order in the confirmation.
  4. In location A's QuickBooks Online company, search the journal entries for work order 1's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The confirmation shows no account notes, as without an integration.

Step 3:

  • The work order is Closed.

Step 4:

  • No entry for work order 1 is found.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11764 (Story 7, QuickBooks Online sync)

  • S7-N1: “If QuickBooks is not connected at the location, nothing is sent and Story 3 behaves exactly as it does without the integration.”
  • S3-E4: “If the shop has no accounting integration at the work order's location, Close shows the confirmation without account notes, and the sentence of S3-R2 is replaced by "This marks the work order Closed · Internal (Closed · No Charge). Parts cost, shop supplies and hours are available in the Internal Work Orders report." (with "This completes the work order and marks it ..." when it is not yet Complete)”
